audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Volibear levels 2 through first item and gave Mel level 1 and 2+ items — the exact inverse of the audited mel-side chart, which reads Skill, Mel, Mel, Mel, Volibear, Skill, Volibear.
audit.why: The mirror audit (audits/top/mel__volibear.json) already set the direction: Mel is a 950/1000-range mage who holds the early levels, Volibear takes over at 6 with Stormbringer and again at two items. Two contradicting charts would ship two answers to 'who wins Level 1'.
audit.corrected: win[0..6] and phases[0..6].side both become Skill, Mel, Mel, Mel, Volibear, Skill, Volibear with inverse ratings 5, 3, 4, 4, 7, 5, 7.

audit.why: Spikes read levels 3-5, level 6, first item, late; the level-6 Stormbringer tower-disable and the Sundered Sky first-item timing are both stated and both real (R cd 160/135/110, disables towers near the landing point).
audit.corrected: Kept the four spike windows; sharpened spikes[0] and spikes[3] with real cooldowns and the correct Rebuttal behaviour.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said Mel's W Rebuttal 'does nothing against a diving juggernaut' and 'is useless against a juggernaut already in melee'. Riot's own text says Rebuttal 'prevents her from taking damage' — it is a damage-immunity, not merely a projectile reflect.
audit.why: Telling a Volibear player that her W is irrelevant in melee makes him spend Thundering Smash and the Frenzied Maul re-bite into a window where none of it lands. Rebuttal is 38s at rank 1, falling to 26s at rank 5 — long enough that baiting it wins the trade outright.
audit.corrected: Leap or walk in first, let Rebuttal burn, then spend Q and the W re-bite after it drops. Solar Snare (E) roots at 1000 range on 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s and is what stops the 300-unit Thundering Smash charge; Radiant Volley (Q) pokes at 950 for 70 mana at rank 1.
sources: brief enemyKit W/E/Q Riot text and cooldowns

audit.why: Sky Splitter (E) carries a 'projectile' derived flag, but Riot's description is 'summons a lightning bolt at a location' — a ground-targeted summon. Per the flag-versus-description rule the mirror made no reflect claim either way, and neither do I.
audit.corrected: No reflect claim written about Sky Splitter in either direction.
sources: brief ownerKit E text vs flags

edits.before: W start for the bite-trade, or Q into aggressive lanes. Even exchanges favour you because the passive lightning ramps as the trade extends.
edits.after: W start for the bite-trade, or Q if you want the level-2 threat. Exchanges stay even while Radiant Volley costs her 70 mana for every poke.

edits.before: Level 1 is a short even skill check before your Q stun is available.
edits.after: Level 1 is an even skill check: no Q stun yet, her Q pokes at 950.

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Mel has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Q charges only 300 units, so Solar Snare's root out at 1000 range stops it before contact — walk up behind minions.

edits.before: Level 2 goes to you as Q closes and W chunks her fragile frame.
edits.after: Level 2 is hers — Solar Snare roots your 300-range Q charge.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Mel under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Sky Splitter shields you at 1200 range and slows her, but Rebuttal prevents damage outright — bait it out before you spend the pattern.

edits.before: Level 3 stays yours — full combo all-in beats her poke and no-escape kit.
edits.after: Level 3 stays hers: Rebuttal blanks damage on a 38s timer at rank 1.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Mel down every time Solar Snare is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard, but Solar Snare is back every 9.5s at rank 4 — you get one clean run at her per rotation.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 remain yours since her damage can't out-trade your sustain.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay hers — 950-range Radiant Volley outranges your bite.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Mel to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Sundered Sky heals on the first hit of every fight. It is even now: she wins if Solar Snare lands, you win if it misses.

edits.before: First item stays yours as your on-hit combo deletes her on contact.
edits.after: First item swings on execution: land Q at 300 range and she dies.

edits.before: Mel is a squishy mage with no reliable escape, so once you have Q Thundering Smash's stun you close the gap and W Frenzied Maul melts her; punish every time she steps up to auto-attack for her passive stacks.
edits.after: Mel is squishy with no dash, but Thundering Smash charges only 300 units — walk up behind minions, bait or eat Solar Snare (11s at rank 1), then Q in and let Frenzied Maul's second bite heal you through her poke.

edits.before: Late you flank with R from fog and instantly kill her; her W Rebuttal can reflect a projectile but does nothing against a diving juggernaut already on top of her.
edits.after: Late you flank with Stormbringer from fog and kill her on contact — but Rebuttal prevents damage entirely, so open with the leap, let her burn it, and Q-stun once it drops.

edits.before: Late game stays firmly yours. With R to flank from fog and a completed item, a single point of contact deletes Mel's squishy body. edits.after: Late game stays firmly yours. With Stormbringer to flank from fog and a completed item, a single point of contact deletes Mel's squishy body. Rebuttal still prevents her taking damage for its duration, so leap first and spend Thundering Smash after it drops rather than into it.

notes: packet suspectName 'Thundering Smash's' is a FALSE POSITIVE — Thundering Smash is Volibear's real Q name per the kit. Kit flag misfire confirmed from the mirror side: volibear E Sky Splitter carries a 'projectile' flag while Riot's text says it summons a bolt at a location; no Rebuttal-reflect claim written about it in either direction. Mel's Rebuttal is a damage-prevention window (38/35/33/29/26s), not just a reflect — that was the page's real error.
